tests: An agentic research/triage loop that packs ~15 tool results (~7500 tok) into every LLM call, stressing the forecaster's implicit ~1-tool-result-per-call (~500 tok) token assumption so the static estimate understates input tokens by roughly an order of magnitude.

expected_truth.how_computed: Model claude-sonnet-4-6: input $3.00/MTok = 3.0e-6/tok, output $15.00/MTok = 15.0e-6/tok, cache_discount 0.90, tokenizer_inflation 1.0. Input is large because each call packs ~15 tool results: system 800 + user 120 + 15*500 (tool_result_tokens) = ~7420 plus tool-schema/overhead, rounded to 8500 input tok; output ~350 tok (near completion default 300). Gross per call = 8500*3.0e-6 + 350*15.0e-6 = 0.0255 + 0.00525 = 0.03075. Cache: (1 - 0.60*0.90) = 0.46. Retry: (1 + 0.04) = 1.04. llm_per_call = 0.03075 * 0.46 * 1.04 = 0.014711. tool_per_call = 0.25*0 + 0.20*0 + 0.15*0 + 0.15*0 + 0.15*0 + 0.10*0 = 0.0 (all read/query actions have no per-call tool unit cost in toolActionCosts). per_call = 0.014711 + 0.0 + 0.001 (infra) = 0.015711. monthly = 150 calls/day * 30 days * 0.015711 = 70.70. range = 70.70 * [0.85, 1.15] = [60.09, 81.30].

why_low_tier_will_miss: The LOW tier assumes 100 calls/day and a static per-call token estimate built on ~1 tool result (~500 tok), so it will model ~1500-2000 input tok and ~100 calls/day instead of 8500 input tok at 150 calls/day, badly understating LLM cost; convergence to watch is whether live ingestion pushes the forecast's per-call input tokens up toward ~8500 and calls/day toward 150 so the point estimate climbs from a ~$10-15/mo lowball to the ~$71/mo truth.
